name: hotel-booking-workspace
description: Monorepo: Hotel Booking — Backend (Spring Boot) + Frontend (React/Vite)

scripts.install:fe: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if (!fs.existsSync('frontend/node_modules')) { console.log('Installing frontend dependencies...'); require('child_process').execSync('npm install --prefix frontend', { stdio: 'inherit' }); }"
scripts.dev:fe: npm run install:fe && npm run dev --prefix frontend
